response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and systems experience, his resume shows minimal direct exposure to Java/Kotlin, JVM tooling, Spring ecosystem, or IDE internals — critical requirements for this role. His Java experience is only mentioned in passing (e.g., robotic arms, device orchestration) without evidence of deep JVM understanding or enterprise framework work, and his focus is overwhelmingly on TypeScript, DLang, and web/mobile stacks.
strengths: Strong systems programming experience with DLang and low-latency systems
Proven ability to build and maintain complex open-source tools and infrastructure
Excellent communication and teaching skills with public workshops and talks
concerns: Lack of demonstrated deep expertise in Java/Kotlin or JVM internals
No evidence of work with Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus, or enterprise build tools
IDE or language tooling experience is absent or tangential to the role
